property_summary: For any two positive amounts sent by a funded sender through receive, the reference C accepts both and ends with depositsCount == 2 and balance == a+b; the mutant rejects the very first deposit (depositsCount stays 0) so its second deposit is also the 'first' success, leaving depositsCount == 1 and balance != a+b after two sends.
change_summary: Insert `require(depositsCount > 0);` before the increment so a first deposit reverts and leaves depositsCount at 0.
